page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.4xlarge is an x86_64 server instance belonging to the Enhanced family. It is provisioned with 16 dedicated virtual CPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, driven by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. The system utilizes KVM virtualization and provides 64.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU.

Hardware architecture highlights include a dedicated CPU allocation, zero bundled hardware accelerators (no GPUs), and a baseline network bandwidth rating of 6 Gbps. The instance comes without local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for all persistent file systems. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which necessitates external networking configurations for direct internet connectivity.

Because of its balanced resource provisioning, ecs.g6t.4xlarge yields consistent core-to-memory proportionality without the overhead of specialized hardware accelerators. This configuration fits standard enterprise workloads, multi-tier web application servers, relational database engines, continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines, and general business logic tasks that require dedicated compute capacity without localized storage disks.
